## Overview

The Circle of the Wild is the church of **Kaelthor**  -  the god of nature and tempest, embodying the untamed world, wilderness, storms, beasts, and raw natural forces. Its shrines are found in wild places rather than cities, and the world itself is considered the only true temple.

## Structure

The Circle has no centralized hierarchy. It is a loose affiliation of druids, rangers, weather-watchers, and nature-attuned individuals who share knowledge and protect sacred sites. Leadership is informal and based on experience and connection to the natural world.

## Membership

- **Druids**: Custodians of the wild who maintain the balance of nature
- **Rangers**: Frontier guides and monster-trackers
- **Weather-Watchers**: Those who read the skies and predict storms
- **Farmers and Sailors**: Common folk who pray for good weather and safe passage

## Goals

- Protect the natural world from the corruption of monsters
- Maintain the balance between civilization and wilderness
- Guide travelers safely through frontier territories
- Restore lands damaged by monster presence

## Headquarters

The Circle has no single headquarters. Its most important sites are ancient groves, sacred mountains, and wild places throughout Kythoria. Its urban presence is strongest on the frontier and in rural settlements.
